title: cwht Risk Register
description: Risk register schema for the cwht transceiver. IDs use RSK-NNN and are never reused. Each risk is the SE HB section 6.4 triplet (scenario, likelihood, consequence) written in the four-part statement format of docs/process/06-risk-and-decision-analysis.md section 4. Likelihood and the five consequence dimensions use the 1 to 5 operational scales of sections 6 and 7 of that document. score = likelihood x max(consequence dimensions). category is the single classifier; the optional tags array carries cross-cutting labels. The SWE-086 software-risk population is category software plus every risk tagged software (section 5). Review points include the delta TRRs TRR-Dn of charter section 3. The candidates array records the disposition of every candidate risk named in another artifact (section 9, Identify). tools/render_risk.py validates the register and renders docs/risk/register.md.

version.description: Register version; bumped at every review baseline (e.g. 0.1.0-pre-srr, 1.0.0-srr)

updated.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last edit to any risk or candidate

candidates.description: Disposition record of candidate risks named in other artifacts (ConOps section 8, research reports, hazard analysis, reviews); process document section 9, Identify

gate.description: Life-cycle gate (charter section 3); Ops = after SAR

review_point.description: Review at which an assessment was made; Pre-SRR = Formulation work before the first gate; TRR-Dn = a delta TRR (charter section 3, 01 section 7.6), written TRR-D1, TRR-D2, ...

decision_memo.description: Path to the review decision memo, or between reviews the ADR decision section or CR disposition block that records the owner's decision (charter section 4 item 4)

id.description: The candidate id as the source artifact writes it (e.g. REG-4, RFX-R1, R-AUD-3)

source_artifact.description: Repository path of the artifact that names the candidate, with section

disposition.description: Entered = became a new RSK; Merged = folded into an existing RSK whose source names the candidate; Declined = not a risk, with rationale

risk_id.description: The RSK that carries an Entered or Merged candidate

rationale.description: Why the candidate was merged or declined, and the condition that would re-open it

title.description: Short noun phrase naming the departure; no solution language

statement.description: Given [condition], there is a possibility of [departure] adversely impacting [asset], leading to [consequence]. The renderer composes the sentence from the four parts.

condition.description: A fact true today, with the evidence or SI/REQ/artifact it rests on

departure.description: The single undesired event, or one failure-mode family admitted by section 4

asset.description: Subsystem, product, process, cost or schedule element affected (RX, TX, PWR, CTL, ME, SW-<sub>, process, ...)

consequence.description: Effect in one or more of the five consequence dimensions, quantified where possible

tags.description: Optional cross-cutting labels; category stays the single classifier. Labels in use: software (a software risk of another category, section 5; required when a step artifact is under docs/requirements/sw/, docs/test_cases/sw-* or firmware/), cyber (cybersecurity risk, 07 section 16.2, SWE-154), hsi (human-systems integration, SEMP section 7.3), single-source (SEMP section 5.13), regulatory (47 CFR exposure), aggregate (likelihood is the maximum of the children in related.risk_ids), cm (configuration management, 05 section 11), spf (a single point failure accepted by the owner, process section 8)

likelihood_rationale.description: Why this level; names the evidence anchor of section 6

consequence.description: One level per dimension (section 7). Overall consequence = max of the five.

consequence_rationale.description: Why the driving dimension has its level; mention any dimension scored 3 or higher

score.description: likelihood x max(consequence); checked by tools/render_risk.py

assessment_confidence.description: Confidence in the likelihood and consequence levels (uncertainty of the assessment); Low requires a Research strategy, a re-assessment trigger or a hazard-analysis step (section 3)

owner.description: Who drives the mitigation plan to closure. Acceptance of any risk is the owner's (Robin's) alone regardless of this field.

source.description: How the risk was identified (review, analysis, SI-NNN, RFA, NCR, trade study, trigger, candidate id from another artifact)

horizon.description: Gate by which the departure would have to occur to matter; likelihood is assessed against this horizon

strategy.description: Mitigate = reduce L or C by steps; Watch = monitor triggers only (not allowed for Red); Accept = owner accepts residual (needs acceptance; not allowed for an active Red risk); Research = reduce assessment uncertainty first; Elevate = owner decision needed to choose a strategy

artifact.description: Repo artifact the step produces or changes

evidence.description: Link to the artifact once Done

response.description: What is done, by whom, by when, when the condition is observed

fallback.description: Contingency if the mitigation steps fail or the departure occurs

plan_approval.description: Owner's approval of the mitigation plan of a Red risk (section 8); required from the first gate review at which the risk was Red

status.description: Transitions per section 9. Proposed = written by the author, awaiting the independent check; Open = checked, plan not started; Mitigating = at least one step InProgress or Done; Watch = triggers only, Yellow or Green band only; Accepted = owner accepted residual risk; Realized = departure occurred (NCR or CR opened); Closed = closure criteria met; Retired = no longer applicable

decision_memo.description: Path to the decision memo, ADR decision section or CR disposition block recording the owner's acceptance (charter section 4 item 4)

residual_score.description: Equals the risk's score at acceptance; checked by tools/render_risk.py

trend.description: Score movement since the previous history entry; New when only one entry exists; Closed when status is Closed or Retired

related.description: Traceability to other identifiers (charter section 6). Arrays may be empty until the artifacts exist; every Red risk has at least one requirement or hazard link by PDR; a Realized risk names its NCR or CR.

closure_criteria.description: Evidence that closes the risk (verified requirement, accepted residual, retired condition)

history.description: Append-only assessment log; the last entry must equal the current likelihood, max consequence, safety consequence, score, status and review

consequence.description: max of the five dimensions at that assessment

safety.description: safety dimension at that assessment, so that the per-review measures can apply the safety override; required on the last entry by tools/render_risk.py
